scope.purpose: Reconcile the 42 provisional VCFv4.5 cardinality/local-allele/Number=M/Number=P supplemental records against the complete canonical 226-record ledger. This is a source-grounded author crosswalk, not canonical promotion.

method: Loaded and inspected all 226 canonical requirement records from the complete repository blob.
Compared each supplemental record's atomic statement, normative force, actor, condition and source locator against canonical records.
Classified direct semantic duplicates, partial/combined overlaps, source-scope conflicts, modality conflicts and records with no canonical match identified.
Used lexical similarity only to identify candidate matches; final relationship classifications are author-reviewed against the stored atomic statements and pinned VCFv4.4/4.5 source passages.

mappings.notes: Canonical VCF-REQ-000072 combines Number=LA and Number=LR in one statement; this addendum separates LA cardinality.
Canonical VCF-REQ-000072 combines Number=LA and Number=LR in one statement; this addendum separates LR cardinality.
Same Number=LG semantics over the LAA-selected allele set.
Same LAA distinct one-based ALT-index definition.
Same rule that LAA order defines local-allele interpretation order.

Canonical VCF-REQ-000053 uses the detailed non-omitted/non-MISSING condition; the earlier FORMAT sentence at VCFv4.5 line 502 states 'if any local-allele field is present'. Retain both readings under VCF45-AMB-007.
Same BCF zero-length LAA/REF-only semantics, but the pinned source says 'should be treated'; canonical VCF-REQ-000054 currently records DESCRIPTIVE force. Do not merge the force discrepancy silently.

Canonical VCF-REQ-000061 combines per-allele eligible-base cardinality and sequence ordering; this addendum separates the ordering.

Canonical records combine PSL and PSO equality across paired breakend records; this addendum splits PSL equality from PSO equality. VCF-REQ-000113 is related coverage; VCF-REQ-000048 and 000142 carry the combined source-level obligation.

unresolved_gates: Independent standards review has not started.

VCF-REQ-000054 and VCF-REQ-000055 in the canonical ledger have normative-force discrepancies against the pinned VCFv4.5 prose (SHOULD vs DESCRIPTIVE); do not silently rewrite canonical records before adjudication.
VCF-REQ-000232 retains the line-502 versus lines-692-696 LAA-presence scope discrepancy (VCF45-AMB-007).
Partial overlaps require a decision whether canonical parent requirements should be split into linked child requirements; no canonical ID changes are authorized by this crosswalk.
The nine records with no canonical match are not yet confirmed net-new requirements; check source context, canonical scope and the existing 61 GT/FORMAT candidates before promotion.
controls: Do not modify atomic-requirements.v1.json from this author crosswalk.
A direct match is a deduplication relationship, not independent approval.
A no-match result is provisional and is not proof of novelty.
Preserve all source locators and version applicability; do not project VCFv4.5 semantics backward.
No implementation mapping, executable test or laboratory qualification is claimed.
